content: The rest of the paper is organized as follows: In Section 2, we provide a detailed description of our methodology and elaborate on the experimentation details. In Section 3, we present our results and analysis on the speculation detection and scope resolution task, using the single dataset and the multiple dataset training approach. In Section 4, we show the results of applying XLNet and RoBERTa on negation detection and scope resolution and propose a few reasons to explain why XLNet performs better than RoBERTa. Finally, the future scope and conclusion is mentioned in Section 5.
